## Recommendations

1. **🎉 `/optimize-vacation-rental-listing/` — Massive jump to page 1 (47.4 → 4.3).** This is the biggest single-week position improvement we've ever seen. However, impressions dropped 76% (148 → 35), which suggests Google may be testing this page in a new SERP position with a smaller query set. The "boost airbnb listing" keyword jumped to position 31 (↑20.1). **Action:** This is a critical moment — improve the title tag and meta description now to maximize CTR while Google is testing. Add internal links from `/vacation-rental-management-software/` and `/blog/` to reinforce authority.

2. **`/es/cuanto-ganar-airbnb-estado-mexico-2026/` — Strong debut at position 6.1 with 84 impressions.** This new content page is already near page 1 in its first week of indexing — the strongest launch of any page so far. **Action:** Monitor next week to see if position settles. Add internal links from `/es/como-invertir-en-airbnb/`, `/es/home-es/`, and `/es/blog-es/`.

3. **`/es/como-invertir-en-airbnb/` — Surging +22.6 positions (69.8 → 47.2).** "invertir en airbnb" jumped from 65 → 35.7, and "como invertir en airbnb" from 57 → 38.3. Impressions up 120%. **Action:** Double down with internal links from the new `/es/cuanto-ganar-airbnb-estado-mexico-2026/` page. These two pages should cross-link.

4. **`/vacation-rental-management-software/` — Position improving (56.3 → 53.5) but impressions declining (-22%).** Several long-tail keywords dropping: "vacation rental software for owners" ↓8.1, "vacation rental booking software" ↓7.9, "property management software vacation rentals" ↓13.6. The primary keyword is steady at 57.2 (↑1.2). **Action:** Investigate competitor content for the dropping long-tail terms. Consider adding comparison tables and strengthening the H2 structure around specific use cases (VRBO management, booking, owner tools).

5. **`/vacation-rental-website-builder/` — Mixed signals.** Overall position improved +5.4 (46.4 → 41.0), but most individual keywords dropped: "short term rental website builder" ↓11.4, "best website builder for short term rentals" ↓14.7, "best website builder for vacation rentals" ↓12.0. Impressions down 40%. **Action:** The page may be consolidating around fewer, stronger keywords. Strengthen content around "vacation rental website maker" (position 37.5, ↑7.1) which is the best-performing variant.

6. **Geo pages are working well.** Three new geo pages indexed this week: Malinalco (9.7), Valle de Bravo (14.8), and planes page (1.0). Metepec steady at 3.3, Toluca at 5.5. **Action:** Continue deploying new city pages. The Valle de Bravo page is picking up "administracion renta vacacional cdmx" — consider adding a dedicated CDMX page to capture this demand directly.

7. **`/create-your-ai-assistant-for-airbnb-in-3-easy-steps/` — Steady at position 5.3 but 0% CTR.** This page has been on page 1 for multiple weeks with 186 impressions and zero clicks. **Action:** Urgently review and rewrite the title tag and meta description. At position 5.3, this page should be generating clicks. A/B test more compelling titles.

8. **Deindexed pages `/es/acerca-de/` and `/es/empieza/` — Low impact.** Both had only 1 impression each. These may have been dropped due to thin content or canonical issues. **Action:** Check if these pages have proper canonical tags and are included in the sitemap. Request re-indexing via URL Inspection if they should be indexed.

9. **`app.bnbuddy.com` URLs appearing in SC data.** Both the app root and a specific property page appeared with 1 impression each. **Action:** Verify that `app.bnbuddy.com` has a proper `robots.txt` disallowing crawling of authenticated app pages, or add `noindex` meta tags. Individual property rental pages may be intentionally indexable for the rentals product.

10. **Overall impressions down 15% for second consecutive week (3,391 → 2,866).** Most of the decline came from `/vacation-rental-management-software/` (-418) and `/vacation-rental-website-builder/` (-170). This may be seasonal or competitive pressure on English-language content. Spanish content is growing. **Action:** Monitor for a third consecutive week of decline. If it continues, a deeper competitive analysis is needed for the English content pages.
